src='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A horizontal 5-bar marks the width to fill from the colored column below it.
    for r in range(h):
        bars = [rr for rr in range(h) if all(grid[rr][c] == 5 for c in range(1, w-1))]
    # Detect each contiguous horizontal 5 run and its colored seed column beneath.
    for rr in range(h):
        cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(grid[rr]) if v == 5]
        if len(cols) >= 3:
            lo, hi = min(cols), max(cols)
            for r in range(rr+1, h):
                if lo < w and grid[r][lo] not in (0, 5):
                    for c in range(lo, hi+1): out[r][c] = grid[r][lo]
    # Vertical 5 bars: fill from horizontal color patterns on their right.
    for c in range(w):
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] == 5]
        if len(rows) < 3: continue
        lo, hi = min(rows), max(rows)
        # Find nonzero pattern rows immediately to the right of the bar.
        seeds = [r for r in range(h) if c+1 < w and any(grid[r][c+1:])]
        if not seeds: continue
        # Adjacent bottom seed row(s) define a repeating vertical pattern.
        last = max(seeds)
        first = last
        while first-1 in seeds: first -= 1
        tile = [grid[r][c+1:] for r in range(first, last+1)]
        for r in range(max(lo, first-len(tile)*10), min(hi, h-1)+1):
            if r < first: out[r][c+1:] = tile[(r-first) % len(tile)][:]
            elif r > first: out[r][c+1:] = tile[(r-first) % len(tile)][:]
    return out
'''
